storyJob: Make the difference between a Claude subscription usage allowance and developer API token billing understandable at a glance.

format.mobileProof: 390x260 crop or resize in which both paths remain distinct

composition.scene: One adult, people-free desk scene divided into two clearly related paths.
composition.leftPath: A consumer tablet or laptop with a simple subscription-card shape beside a clock or time-window gauge. The gauge can show that an allowance exists, but must not show an invented quantity or a universal access badge.
composition.rightPath: A developer laptop with abstract code blocks or text-piece tiles flowing through a usage meter into a receipt shape. It should convey metered processing without readable code, a dollar total or a claim of savings.
composition.relationship: The paths sit side by side and remain visibly separate. No arrow should merge them into one charge.
composition.priorityAtMobile: The subscription/time symbol and API/usage-meter symbol must remain identifiable without relying on labels.

requiredTruths: Subscription limits and API token billing are separate mechanisms.
The image does not quantify Anthropic's newly increased five-hour subscription limits.
The image does not imply every paid account can select Opus 5.5.
The image does not depict provider benchmark claims as independently proven.
The scene contains no person, mascot, product logo or imitation interface.
avoid: invented prices, percentages, savings, limit quantities or plan badges
a universal unlocked or checkmarked access state
conversation-to-checklist imagery from the prior Cowork story
shopping cards or measuring tapes from the sponsored-agent story
generic humanoid robots, glowing brains or circuitry as the main subject
MAiVEN, TRAILBLAZER or any reusable person asset
CSS or SVG imitation of artwork

styleAuthority.governs: Adult editorial/comic detail, meaningful object action, print texture and electric accents. It is a style reference, not a reusable whole scene.

requiredAdmission: Maker inspects actual full-size pixels and 390x260 evidence against this brief and the unchanged article.
A reviewer independent from the image maker judges semantic alignment, style, object coherence, text integrity and mobile legibility.
Only a PASS bound to exact image and companion hashes permits heroVisual binding.
After binding, rebuild the candidate package and run the full unmodified run-pilot preflight before editorial review.
